summary: XTL Biopharmaceuticals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a definitive share purchase agreement to acquire all share capital of PsygaBio Ltd. XTL will issue ADSs representing 40% of its outstanding shares to Psyga's shareholders; no cash consideration is paid. Additional milestone-based earn-out shares of up to 30% may be issued. The transaction is structured as a share-for-share acquisition. Psyga is a psychedelic mushroom biotech with Phase 2a trials and a GMP facility. The board did not disclose a formal recommendation or advisors. The transaction requires customary closing conditions. Watch for regulatory approvals and the post-close ownership structure, as XTL shareholders will be diluted to a minority stake.
